definitions.gloss: forgery (of an artwork); a fake painting
definitions.explanation: A work of art or craft made to pass as the work of a famous artist, or the making of one. Used of paintings, pottery, calligraphy and antiques; the opposite is {真作|しんさく} (an authentic work).

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{贋作|がんさく}だった。
{贋作|がんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}{抜|ぬ}く→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。

⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{贋作|がんさく}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧わかった。
examples.english: A work the museum had paid a lot for later turned out to be a fake.

notes:
{贋|がん} (counterfeit) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work). The word of art dealers, museums and news reports; in everyday talk ⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧ covers any fake.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贋作|がんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}{抜|ぬ}く→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧: to spot a forgery
- {贋作|がんさく}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: an art forgery case
- {贋作|がんさく}{師|し}: an art forger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧: a fake of any kind (bags, money, people)
- ⟦{偽造|ぎぞう}→偽造：11524_gizou⟧: forging or counterfeiting in general (documents, banknotes, cards); {贋作|がんさく} is the specific word for an art forgery
